changes.comment: Redact tool call invocations and arguments in the conversation projection. Secret masking and workspace/home path renaming now apply to every displayed member of a tool call, and a call's structured payloads are redacted by walking the JSON value, so a secret written into a nested object or a multi-line .env is masked and the payload is still valid JSON. The redaction rules themselves moved to @excitedjs/dreamux-utils, where the host logger and config display now share one list of secret key names; the logger previously missed api_key, private_key, and client_secret.
